records.title: Learning to Efficiently Sample from Diffusion Probabilistic Models
records.reason: Full text confirms the method accelerates denoising-diffusion sampling (up to 32 refinement steps for image-generation DDPMs), a distinct generative process. It is not a language-model decoder, LLM serving optimization, or an applicable attention/KV-cache method; shared inference-systems lineage alone does not create a technical connection.

records.title: Mask CTC: Non-Autoregressive End-to-End ASR with CTC and Mask Predict
records.reason: Primary text confirms Mask-CTC is a non-autoregressive speech-recognition decoder with iterative mask prediction and CTC. Parallel sequence decoding is adjacent to decoding-efficiency research, but its speech-recognition model and objective do not establish relevance to LLM inference systems. Keep borderline for possible cross-task decoding-method lineage review.

records.title: Deep learning for financial forecasting: A review of recent trends
records.reason: The publisher abstract reviews deep-learning architectures and forecasting tasks in finance; the application domain and contribution are forecasting review, not LLM inference.

records.title: On The Landscape of Spoken Language Models: A Comprehensive Survey
records.reason: The survey covers spoken-language-model architectures and audio tasks; it does not propose concrete compute/memory/latency optimization for LLM inference.

records.title: Non-Autoregressive Machine Translation with Auxiliary Regularization
records.reason: Full text confirms non-autoregressive machine translation with an auxiliary regularization/training objective. Parallel decoding for translation is adjacent to inference decoding research, but it is a task-specific MT model and does not demonstrate a transferable LLM serving or inference optimization.
